podcast.title: Jerry Lee's Mentor
podcast.body: Paul Whitehead was considered a mentor to Jerry Lee Lewis, although Lewis eventually knew he was destined for greatness on his own. Only one recording exists of Mr. Paul's piano part on an obscure rockabilly song. "There's only one recording available of Lewis's mentor, Mr. Paul, his piano part on an obscure rockabilly song."

srcs.source: A History of Rock Music in 500 Songs
srcs.episode: Episode 59: "Whole Lotta Shakin' Goin' On" by Jerry Lee Lewis

podcast.title: Touring Partner
podcast.body: Paul Whitehead, a blind musician known as "Mr. Paul," toured with Jerry Lee Lewis, with Whitehead playing violin, accordion, and piano, while Lewis played piano and drums interchangeably. "He'd been touring with the blind musician called Paul Whitehead."
